about_the_game:
Banquet Simulator

We’ve fused a card game with the Chinese art of banquet politics to create the ultimate dinner-table experience. Build your own deck, meet dozens of wildly different NPCs, and rewrite the rules of Chinese dining etiquette with every round of baijiu.

Key Features

• No Two Tables Alike: Procedurally generated guests, seating orders, dishes, and surprise events ensure every banquet feels both brand-new and eerily familiar.
• Guanxi Deck: 100+ unique cards—catchphrases, toasts, favors, and tricks—let the same sentence or drink land in endlessly fresh ways.
• Atmosphere Meter: A visible “vibe” scale can be weaponized to flip the table or torpedoed by a single bad joke; one line can make or break the night.
• NPC Bonds: Bosses, childhood friends, clients, exes, future in-laws—every character arrives with backstory and baggage. Toast them or throw them under the bus; they’ll remember and repay the favor (or vendetta) at the next banquet.
• Permanent Growth: Whether you exit in glory or crash in cringe, you’ll bring home “social savvy” to unlock new cards, identities, and opening lines—growing smoother with every sip, clearer with every hangover.

Gameplay

Assemble the Table: Pick your role (newbie, veteran, host), choose a starter deck, and bring a “kickoff bottle” (your opening skill) into the feast.

Turn Flow: On your turn, play cards and interact with NPCs in real time; every move shifts the global vibe and your relationships.

Meta-Loop: Use what you earned to upgrade your deck, unlock new roles, and rewrite your opening toast—then step into the next round of your protagonist’s lifelong drinking odyssey.

Solo Story Mode: Follow three pivotal banquets—“Promotion Dinner,” “Blind-Date Banquet,” and “Family Reunion Feast”—and survive the three toughest battles in a Chinese lifetime.

content_descriptors.notes: This game depicts alcohol consumption, tobacco use, and fictional unauthorized drug use solely for simulation purposes. These elements are not intended to encourage or glorify real-life substance abuse. Players are advised to prioritize physical and mental health. Minors should play under parental guidance.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win10/win11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win10/win11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K or AMD R7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or AMD RX6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Chinese Dinner Gathering is a turn-based card-battler that distills the perilous art of Chinese dinner politics. Build your own deck, pick your style and duel with guanxi itself. Every round brings new faces and new rules, while your deck keeps growing and the game of social chess never ends.
